title: lint: a flow node config-value finding (validateStackExpressions) carries only `where` prose and no key path, so Studio's Problems row lists it but cannot point at the node
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ① product defect with reach measured, found while landing #27799 (PR #27826, report 6512261435, `out_of_scope_findings`).
Reach: Studio → Automations, any flow whose node config value the publish verdict refuses (measured on a blank expression in an Update Records value, `main` `86aaff32`). After PR #27826, the Problems list shows the finding, but its row cannot select or reveal the node; it can only print the server's locator text.
Business reason: Problems is how an author finds what blocks Publish. A row that names a node in prose but does not take them there makes a large flow slow to fix, and the canvas badge never appears on that node.
Reader who acts: the lane that owns `packages/lint` (spec lane per the #27482 precedent). The ui side needs no change: `flow-problems.ts` `serverTarget` already maps a `flows[0].nodes[N].config…` / `nodes.N…` path onto the node.
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "lint ExprIssue path flow node config value slot key path where prose Problems" → 1 hit, #17305 (closed, template-path rule scope), which is not this. The same producer shape blocked #27482's Validations arm (validation-rule findings carry `where` only), and flow edges got a key path in #26858; this is the node-config sibling.

## What happens

`validateStackExpressions` (`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`) reports a flow node's config-value finding (e.g. `expression-invalid` on `config.fields.id`) with `where` = `flow 'x' · node 'y' (update_record) … at config.fields.id` and no `path`. `authoring-rules.ts` sets `path: i.path ?? i.where`, so the draft read's `_diagnostics` path is prose. Studio cannot place it on an element.

## Expected

The finding carries a key path to the node's config value (e.g. `nodes.<index>.config.fields.id`, the same shape the edge findings use since #26858). The prose `where` stays for the CLI. With that path, Studio's existing mapping badges the node and selects it from Problems, with no ui change.

## Acceptance

- A lint pin: a flow node config-value finding carries the key path.
- `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate` (or its successor) pins the draft read's `_diagnostics` path for that finding.
- Optional ui pin (separate lane): the Problems row for that finding selects the node.

Related: #27799 / PR #27826, #27482 (the validation-rule sibling, in retriage), #26858 (edges).
